## Definition of done

Check every item. If an item does not apply to this change, check it.

- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] A new table has a migration, RLS on, an isolation test, and regenerated types
- [ ] A new action or role has a row in the permissions grid test
- [ ] Every server action checks input with zod, gets the actor, and calls `can()`
- [ ] Colors and sizes are tokens only
- [ ] Only fictional data
- [ ] No health content in logs
- [ ] One CHANGELOG.md line
- [ ] Copy checked for no medical advice
- [ ] Works at phone width and with the keyboard and a screen reader
